question:
Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dispel
solution:
The correct answer is **"Integrate."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **"Dispel"** means to make something go away or disappear. ((शंका आदि को) दूर कर देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *His reassuring words **dispelled**__ all her fears.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **"dispel"** is **"integrate."**
 
• **"Integrate"** means to join things so that they become one thing or work together. (वस्‍तुओं को ऐसे जोड़ना कि वे एक हो जाएँ या साथ काम करें; एकीकृत करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The two small schools were **integrated**__ into one large one.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "scatter"**, means to spread things apart or make them disorganized. ((लोगों या पशुओं के समूह का) तितर-बितर हो जाना, विभिन्‍न दिशाओं में तेज़ी से बिखर जाना)
 
• **Option 2, "remove"**, means to take something away or eliminate it. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को हटा या मिटा देना)
 
• **Option 3, "disburse"**, means to distribute or give out money or resources. (उद्देश्य विशेष से इकट्ठा किए गए धन से पैसे देना; चुकाना, अदा करना; ख़र्चा करना, व्यय करना)
